articles.title: Ola Electric shares soar 10%, stock rallies 86% in 6 months. More upside ahead?
articles.summary: Ola Electric Mobility shares surged nearly 10% on Wednesday, extending sharp gains for the third consecutive session and rallying over 86% in just six months after hitting a record low in March this year.Shares of the EV scooter-maker soared to Rs 41.44 apiece on NSE on Wednesday morning, pushing its market capitalisation beyond Rs 19,000 crore. This came on the back of strong trading volumes on the counter.Despite the recent gains, the shares of Bhavish Aggarwal’s company remain in the deep red for its IPO investors. After a flat market debut in August 2024, Ola shares rallied sharply to hit a lifetime high of Rs 157.40 apiece later that year. But the momentum reversed dramatically, with the stock falling to a lifetime low in March 2026, nearly one-seventh of its peak value.Also read | Ather & Ola Electric: A tale of two contrasting ridesOla Electric shares have seen sharp upswings and downswings this year. The stock had crashed more than 62% from its 52-week high of Rs 59.2 apiece, which it had hit in September last year, to a 52-week low of Rs 22.25 apiece in March this year. However, the stock soon staged a sharp recovery. Overall, Ola Electric shares have gained 9% in 2026 so far, as strong sales data, PLI incentives and other factors boosted investor confidence in the EV scooter-maker. Should you buy, sell or hold Ola Electric shares?Ola Electric last month reported a reduction in net loss to Rs 336 crore in Q1 FY27, down from Rs 428 crore in the same period last year, although revenue from operations fell 45% year-on-year.Following the Q1 results, brokerages continued to remain bearish on the stock. Citi maintained its ‘Sell’ call on the shares of Ola Electric, with a target price of Rs 26 apiece. Weaker volumes and lower gross margin were offset by cost control and PLI penalty reversal, it said.Kotak Institutional Equities also maintained its ‘Sell’ call on the shares of Ola Electric, with a target price of Rs 20 apiece. The brokerage noted that the company’s volume scale remains the critical hurdle.Goldman Sachs has a ‘Neutral’ rating on the shares of Ola Electric with a target price of Rs 40 apiece. The company’s cash burn remains a concern, with FCF at negative Rs 3.5 billion and no material cell revenue expected in Q2, the international brokerage said.Also read | Voltas share price: Nuvama upgrades rating but Jefferies cuts target price after analyst meet. articles.title: Arvind SmartSpaces shares rally 11% as bookings cross Rs 500 crore in Bengaluru project
articles.summary: Shares of Arvind SmartSpaces surged 10.83% to Rs 651.95 on the BSE in Wednesday’s trading session after the real estate developer announced strong customer response to its latest premium residential project, Arvind Sylva – The Green Reserve, in Bengaluru.The company said bookings for the project crossed Rs 500 crore within 30 days of its launch, translating into approximately 60% inventory absorption by value. Arvind SmartSpaces acquired the project on an outright basis in February 2026, with an estimated topline potential of around Rs 860 crore.Located on Sarjapur Road, one of Bengaluru’s key residential and commercial growth corridors, Arvind Sylva offers connectivity to major employment hubs, including the Outer Ring Road, Electronic City and Whitefield.Spread across 4.7 acres, the project comprises around 375 premium residences and has been designed with a nature-focused theme. According to the company, more than 70% of the development will comprise open spaces, alongside over 1,000 varieties of flora, a 15,000+ sq ft clubhouse and more than 40 curated lifestyle amenities.Commenting on the launch performance, Priyansh Kapoor, Managing Director & CEO of Arvind SmartSpaces, said the project is the company’s largest vertical development launched so far. He added that the booking response validates the company’s market selection and its move into the premium high-rise segment.Arvind SmartSpaces, part of the Lalbhai Group, has a real estate development portfolio spanning approximately 100.1 million sq ft, according to the company. Established in 2008, the Ahmedabad-headquartered developer operates across multiple real estate markets in India.Arvind SmartSpaces share price, valuation & technical indicatorsFollowing Wednesday’s sharp rise, Arvind SmartSpaces shares have gained around 18% over the past week, highlighting strong momentum in the stock.
